overall_prep_notes: Total prep time across all 10 manipulatives is approximately 2 hours. The bulk is M1 Button Set (printing 50 button cards per pair) and M4 Number Line Floor Mat (large format). Plan to print and laminate over a weekend. The three character puppets (Lila, Otto, Scoot) should be printed on cardstock for years of reuse. Base-ten rods (M3) are a standard math-kit item; confirm you have ~5 ten-rods + 20 ones per child before Lesson 2.

assets.name: Lila's Button Set
assets.purpose: Per-pair set of 50 small printed button cards in 5 colours (10 each). Used for Lesson 1 estimation, Lesson 3 base-ten decomposition, Lesson 4 compare-the-jar.
assets.page_layout: Two letter pages, portrait. Page 1 holds 30 small button cards in a 5x6 grid. Page 2 holds 20 cards in a 4x5 grid. Each card ~1in × 1in with thin cut-lines.

image_placeholders.description: A small 1in × 1in card showing a single button in B&W line-art: round shape with 4 small holes. Repeated 50 times across 2 pages, in 5 colour-pattern variants (solid, stripes, dots, checker, swirl) so each pair has 10 of each variant.
image_placeholders.placement: 5x6 grid on page 1, 4x5 grid on page 2.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M1_BUTTON_CARD: keywords (button, card) name what the card shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 set per pair (10 sets for a class of 20 = 20 pages).
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut along cut-lines into 50 single button cards per set.
Store in labelled zip-top bags (50 buttons per bag).
Optional: substitute real buttons from a sewing kit if you have a 500-button stash.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 set per pair = 10 sets for a class of 20.

assets.name: Estimation Button Jar
assets.purpose: Clear jar with 35-50 buttons. Used in Lesson 1 estimate-then-count and Lesson 4 compare-the-jar.
assets.page_layout: Single letter page, portrait. A jar template that the teacher prints and uses as a label for the real glass jar.

image_placeholders.description: A jar-label template in B&W line-art, ~5in tall. Header 'Estimation Jar — Lila's Buttons'. Decorative button icons around the border.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M2_JAR_LABEL: keywords (jar, label) name what the template is for.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 jar label per classroom (1 page).
Laminate; tape to a real clear glass jar.
Fill the jar with 38 buttons on Day 1; swap to 50 on Day 4.
Place the jar at the carpet during Minds On.
Optional: keep 2 jars (38 + 50) for compare-the-jar in Lesson 4.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 jar template + 1 real jar (or 2 for Lesson 4 compare).

assets.name: Base-Ten Rods
assets.purpose: Per-child set: 5 ten-rods + 20 single ones. Used for Lesson 2 representations and Lesson 3 compose/decompose.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — physical rods from the classroom kit. Page is a labelling template for storage.

image_placeholders.description: A storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, in B&W line-art. Shows 1 ten-rod illustration with header 'BASE-TEN RODS — 5 tens + 20 ones per child'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M3_BASE_TEN_LABEL: keywords (base-ten, rods, label) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Prep this step carefully. Confirm you have a class set of base-ten rods (5 ten-rods + 20 ones per child = ~120 ten-rods + ~480 singles for a class of 20).
Print storage labels; tape to each child's bag.
Sort into per-child bags before Lesson 2.
Have bags ready at the start of Lessons 2 and 3.
Optional: use printed base-ten rod cards if you don't have physical rods.
assets.quantity_per_class: 5 ten-rods + 20 ones per child = 120 + 400 for class of 20.

assets.name: Number Line Floor Mat
assets.purpose: Long printable floor strip showing numbers 0 to 50. Children walk it for skip-counting (Lesson 1) and ordering (Lesson 4).
assets.page_layout: 11 letter pages, landscape. Each page holds 5 cells of the Number Line; 11 pages tile to 55 cells (0 to 50 with margin).

image_placeholders.description: A 5-cell horizontal Number Line tile in B&W line-art. Each cell ~2in square with the numeral printed in the centre. Cells border each other with thin cut-lines so multiple pages tile seamlessly.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M4_NUMBER_LINE_PAGE: keywords (number-line, floor, cells) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print all 11 pages on cardstock if available; otherwise paper + laminate.
Laminate each page before assembly.
Prep this step carefully. Tape pages together (or use removable painter's tape) to make a continuous strip ~25ft long.
Lay the strip on the carpet for Lessons 1 and 4; roll up after each lesson.
Optional: use a long roll of paper instead of tiled letter pages.

assets.name: Fair-Share Pizza Cards
assets.purpose: Printable pizza cards showing whole, halved, fourthed, and other unit-fraction cuts. Used in Lesson 5 fraction reveal.
assets.page_layout: Single letter page, portrait. Six pizza diagrams in a 2x3 grid: whole, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5, 1/6.

image_placeholders.description: Six circular pizza diagrams in a 2x3 grid in B&W line-art. Each pizza ~3in diameter. Pizza 1: whole (no division). Pizza 2: divided into 2 halves. Pizza 3: thirds. Pizza 4: fourths. Pizza 5: fifths. Pizza 6: sixths. Each pizza has a thin black border and pizza-style decorative bumps on the edge.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M5_PIZZA_FRACTIONS: keywords (pizza, fractions, halves, fourths) name what the diagrams show.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 page per pair (10 pages for class of 20).
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut along the borders to free the 6 pizzas per set.
Stack pizzas in a labelled folder; distribute at start of Lesson 5.
Prep this step carefully. Optional: substitute real paper plates cut into halves and fourths if you prefer hands-on cutting.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 set per pair = 10 sets for a class of 20.

assets.name: Sharing Paper Plates
assets.purpose: Set of 4 paper plates per group of 4. Used for fair-sharing rounds in Lesson 5.
assets.page_layout: Single letter page, portrait. Four paper-plate templates in a 2x2 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Four paper-plate templates in B&W line-art, ~3.5in diameter each, arranged 2x2. Each plate has a wavy double-line edge and a small label space.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M6_PLATE_TEMPLATE: keywords (plate, share) name what the template shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 page per group of 4 students (5 pages for class of 20).
Laminate before cutting.
Cut into 4 plates per page.
Distribute at the start of Lesson 5 small-group time.
Optional: use real paper plates from the supply closet.
assets.quantity_per_class: 4 plates per group = 5 sets for a class of 20.

assets.name: Number-Word Match Cards
assets.purpose: Per-pair set of 30 cards: 10 numerals + 10 number-words + 10 representations. Used in Lesson 2 gallery walk.
assets.page_layout: Two letter pages, portrait. Page 1 holds 15 cards (5 numerals + 5 words + 5 reps). Page 2 holds 15 more.

image_placeholders.description: A 1.5in × 1in card in B&W line-art. Each card shows ONE form of a number: a numeral (large bold), a number-word (cursive font), or a small representation (ten-frame, base-ten rod, or tally marks). 30 cards per set covering numbers 5, 12, 25, 38, 50, 47, 30, 20, 15, 10.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M7_MATCH_CARD: keywords (card, number, match) name what the cards show.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 set of 2 pages per pair (10 sets for class of 20 = 20 pages).
Laminate before cutting.
Cut into 30 individual cards per set.
Store in labelled zip-top bags.
Optional: ELL/FSL classrooms — replace English number-words with bilingual cards.
assets.quantity_per_class: 30 cards per pair = 10 sets for a class of 20.

assets.name: Lila Lead Counter Puppet
assets.purpose: Printable Lila illustration mounted on a popsicle stick, used as the unit's lead character.

image_placeholders.description: Lila illustration in B&W line-art: a young Grade-1er with bright orange overalls and button-collection apron, light brown hair in a side ponytail, friendly smile, holding a clear jar of buttons. ~6in tall on a letter page with 1in attachment tab.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image CHAR_LILA_FRONT: keywords (lila, puppet) name what the figure shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 page on cardstock if possible.
Cut around Lila's silhouette including the tab.
Glue or tape a popsicle stick behind the tab.
Optional: laminate before cutting.
Store flat in a folder.

assets.name: Otto Partner Puppet
assets.purpose: Printable Otto illustration on a popsicle stick — Lila's pair partner.

image_placeholders.description: Otto illustration in B&W line-art: a young Grade-1er with green plaid shirt, rolled-up jeans, dark curly hair, holding two jars of marbles. ~6in tall with attachment tab.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image CHAR_OTTO_FRONT: keywords (otto, puppet) name what the figure shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 page on cardstock if possible.
Cut around Otto's silhouette including the tab.
Glue or tape a popsicle stick behind the tab.
Optional: laminate before cutting.
Store next to the Lila puppet so they always travel together.

assets.name: Scoot Counting Companion
assets.purpose: Printable Scoot puppy mascot. Appears in every lesson with a 'how many' speech bubble.

image_placeholders.description: Scoot puppy illustration in B&W line-art: a small smiling puppy (golden retriever style) with a red collar and a small COUNT bandana, standing alertly. ~6in tall with attachment tab. Used as a puppet on a popsicle stick.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image CHAR_SCOOT_FRONT: keywords (scoot, puppy) name what the figure shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 page on cardstock if possible.
Cut around Scoot's silhouette.
Glue or tape a popsicle stick behind the tab.
Optional: laminate before cutting.
Bring out for every lesson alongside Lila and Otto.
